caption:
I just wanted to see if this place actually exists in the records or if I’m just hallucinating the architecture. One ping to the network should have been enough to settle the doubt. Instead, the pods started racing like they were trying to outrun something. Then the terminal flickered, and it didn't give me an error. It gave me a greeting. 

The terminal remains active, displaying a history she doesn't remember.

#NeoTokyo #OldTokyo #GhostInTheMachine #Subject01 #GlitchInReality #Cyberpunk #DigitalArcheology
